tldr: Moon through the 8th house brings focus to shared resources, debt, intimacy, grief, and entanglement.
body: Moon transiting the 8th house stirs shared resources, debt, intimacy, grief, and entanglement. For about two to three days, emotion, instinct, and immediate need move through this part of life, making it harder to ignore what needs attention here. This is a fast emotional transit: it shows what needs care today, not necessarily what needs to define the whole season.
business: Moon supports shared money and deep trust: make the call, update the plan, handle the visible task, and let the transit move something practical.
shadow: Mood-driven choices, insecurity, or control, avoidance, or crisis attachment.
advice: Tend the feeling in the 8th house deliberately. Work with shared resources, debt, intimacy, grief, and entanglement without letting the transit run the whole room.
note: Authored from Marie Satori house-transit material.
